# OBJECTIVE
This document reports on the **direct gradient analysis using CCA** of the combined R1 experiment performed in the Fall of 2023 (completed Dec 2023) and R2 experiment performed in the Spring of 2024 (completed June 2024). Data represents the output of Miseq (R1) and NextSeq (R2) sequencing run of the Tri5 Mutant Microbiome project (Guixia Hao & Briana K. Whitaker & Nick Rhoades). 


```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide', include=FALSE} 
x<-c("ggplot2", "phyloseq", "dplyr", "RColorBrewer", "DESeq2", "vegan", "RRPP",
     "viridis")
lapply(x, require, character.only = TRUE)

#set seed
set.seed(128)

#Load functions
source("./code/multiplot.function.R")
`%nin%` = Negate(`%in%`)

# set ggplot2 theme
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size=12)) 
theme_update(panel.grid.major=element_line(0), panel.grid.minor=element_line(0))

strain_col <- c("#D95F02", "#7570B3", "#1B9E77") #brewer.pal(3, name = "Dark2")

```

# Load Phyloseq
```{r}
load("./data/ps_r1b_curated2.RData"); ps_r1b
load("./data/ps_r1f_curated2.RData"); ps_r1f
load("./data/ps_r2b_curated2.RData"); ps_r2b
load("./data/ps_r2f_curated2.RData"); ps_r2f
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide'}
SbyE_r1b <- (as(sample_data(ps_r1b), "data.frame"))
SbyE_r1f <- (as(sample_data(ps_r1f), "data.frame"))
SbyE_r2b <- (as(sample_data(ps_r2b), "data.frame"))
SbyE_r2f <- (as(sample_data(ps_r2f), "data.frame"))

SbyS_r1b <- (as(otu_table(ps_r1b), "matrix"))
SbyS_r1f <- (as(otu_table(ps_r1f), "matrix"))
SbyS_r2b <- (as(otu_table(ps_r2b), "matrix"))
SbyS_r2f <- (as(otu_table(ps_r2f), "matrix"))
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
#first make Strain names shorter,
levels(SbyE_r1b$Strain) <- c("PH1", "Tri5", "Cont")
levels(SbyE_r1f$Strain) <- c("PH1", "Tri5", "Cont")
levels(SbyE_r2b$Strain) <- c("PH1", "Tri5", "Cont")
levels(SbyE_r2f$Strain) <- c("PH1", "Tri5", "Cont")

# change chamber names
levels(SbyE_r1b$Chamber.Rep) <- c("C1", "C2")  #H now C1, J now C2
levels(SbyE_r1f$Chamber.Rep) <- c("C1", "C2")
levels(SbyE_r2b$Chamber.Rep) <- c("C1", "C2")
levels(SbyE_r2f$Chamber.Rep) <- c("C1", "C2")

# then make combo treatment
SbyE_r1b$Strain_Chamber <- as.factor(paste(SbyE_r1b$Strain, SbyE_r1b$Chamber.Rep, sep = "_"))
SbyE_r1f$Strain_Chamber <- as.factor(paste(SbyE_r1f$Strain, SbyE_r1f$Chamber.Rep, sep = "_"))
SbyE_r2b$Strain_Chamber <- as.factor(paste(SbyE_r2b$Strain, SbyE_r2b$Chamber.Rep, sep = "_"))
SbyE_r2f$Strain_Chamber <- as.factor(paste(SbyE_r2f$Strain, SbyE_r2f$Chamber.Rep, sep = "_"))

# and change order
SbyE_r1b$Strain_Chamber <- factor(SbyE_r1b$Strain_Chamber, 
    levels = c("PH1_C1",  "PH1_C2",  "Tri5_C1", "Tri5_C2", "Cont_C1", "Cont_C2") )
SbyE_r1f$Strain_Chamber <- factor(SbyE_r1f$Strain_Chamber, 
    levels = c("PH1_C1",  "PH1_C2",  "Tri5_C1", "Tri5_C2", "Cont_C1", "Cont_C2") )
SbyE_r2b$Strain_Chamber <- factor(SbyE_r2b$Strain_Chamber, 
    levels = c("PH1_C1",  "PH1_C2",  "Tri5_C1", "Tri5_C2", "Cont_C1", "Cont_C2") )
SbyE_r2f$Strain_Chamber <- factor(SbyE_r2f$Strain_Chamber, 
    levels = c("PH1_C1",  "PH1_C2",  "Tri5_C1", "Tri5_C2", "Cont_C1", "Cont_C2") )

```




```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide'}
load("./data/Tri5MB_dds_r1b.RData")
load("./data/Tri5MB_dds_r1f.RData")
load("./data/Tri5MB_dds_r2b.RData")
load("./data/Tri5MB_dds_r2f.RData")


## VST & Euclidean of VST
VST_r1b <- getVarianceStabilizedData(dds_r1b)
VST_r1b <- t(VST_r1b)  #taxa as columns
dist_r1b <- stats::dist(VST_r1b, method="euclidean")

VST_r1f <- getVarianceStabilizedData(dds_r1f)
VST_r1f <- t(VST_r1f)  #taxa as columns
dist_r1f <- stats::dist(VST_r1f, method="euclidean")

VST_r2b <- getVarianceStabilizedData(dds_r2b)
VST_r2b <- t(VST_r2b)  #taxa as columns
dist_r2b <- stats::dist(VST_r2b, method="euclidean")

VST_r2f <- getVarianceStabilizedData(dds_r2f)
VST_r2f <- t(VST_r2f)  #taxa as columns
dist_r2f <- stats::dist(VST_r2f, method="euclidean")

# no Fus versions
ps_noFus_r1f <- prune_taxa(taxa_names(ps_r1f)[taxa_names(ps_r1f) != "ASV1"] , ps_r1f)

ps_noFus_r2f <- prune_taxa(taxa_names(ps_r2f)[taxa_names(ps_r2f) != "ASV1"] , ps_r2f)
load("./data/Tri5MB_dds_noFus_r2f.RData")
VST_noFus_r2f <- getVarianceStabilizedData(dds_noFus_r2f)
VST_noFus_r2f <- t(VST_noFus_r2f)  #taxa as columns
dist_noFus_r2f <- stats::dist(VST_noFus_r2f, method="euclidean")
```

# CCA
#### PH1 & Tri5 mutant treatments only
```{r, include = FALSE}
SbyE_r1b %>% filter(Strain == "PH1" | Strain == "Tri5") %>% 
    select(FgTa_ratio, ugDON_per_g) %>% as.matrix -> SbyE_r1b_sub 

SbyE_r1f %>% filter(Strain == "PH1" | Strain == "Tri5") %>% 
    select(FgTa_ratio, ugDON_per_g) %>% as.matrix -> SbyE_r1f_sub 

SbyE_r2b %>% filter(Strain == "PH1" | Strain == "Tri5") %>% 
    select(FgTa_ratio, ugDON_per_g) %>% as.matrix -> SbyE_r2b_sub 

SbyE_r2f %>% filter(Strain == "PH1" | Strain == "Tri5") %>% 
    select(FgTa_ratio, ugDON_per_g) %>% as.matrix -> SbyE_r2f_sub 

# # check correlations (same for b and f, within rounds)
# cor(SbyE_r1b_sub) # 0.616
# cor(SbyE_r2b_sub) # 0.783

VST_r1b[rownames(VST_r1b) %in% rownames(SbyE_r1b_sub), ] -> VST_r1b_sub
VST_r1f[rownames(VST_r1f) %in% rownames(SbyE_r1f_sub), ] -> VST_r1f_sub
VST_r2b[rownames(VST_r2b) %in% rownames(SbyE_r2b_sub), ] -> VST_r2b_sub
VST_r2f[rownames(VST_r2f) %in% rownames(SbyE_r2f_sub), ] -> VST_r2f_sub
```

#### tweak to r2b
* for this dataset only, VST is causing an error in CCA, rowSums (sample sums) have a lot of negative values. 
```{r r2bFix, results = 'hide'}
min(VST_r2b_sub) #-2.926381   # NOTE - all other dataframes, this min value is positive

# add value across matrix
VST_r2b_sub <- VST_r2b_sub + 3
```


## Permutation tests
```{r}
## CCA
cca_r1b <- vegan::cca(VST_r1b_sub ~ SbyE_r1b_sub )
cca_r1f <- vegan::cca(VST_r1f_sub ~ SbyE_r1f_sub )
cca_r2b <- vegan::cca(VST_r2b_sub ~ SbyE_r2b_sub )
cca_r2f <- vegan::cca(VST_r2f_sub ~ SbyE_r2f_sub )
```

### for the constrained ordination
```{r}
cca_fit_r1b <- envfit(cca_r1b, SbyE_r1b_sub, perm = 999); cca_fit_r1b
cca_fit_r1f <- envfit(cca_r1f, SbyE_r1f_sub, perm = 999); cca_fit_r1f
cca_fit_r2b <- envfit(cca_r2b, SbyE_r2b_sub, perm = 999); cca_fit_r2b
cca_fit_r2f <- envfit(cca_r2f, SbyE_r2f_sub, perm = 999); cca_fit_r2f
#both variables signif in all cases
```

### for cca under reduced model (Marginal tests for axes)
```{r}
anova(cca_r1b, by = "axis", permutations = (nperm=999))   #CCA1 signif
anova(cca_r1f, by = "axis", permutations = (nperm=999))   #CCA1 signif (.050)
anova(cca_r2b, by = "axis", permutations = (nperm=999))   #CCA1 signif
anova(cca_r2f, by = "axis", permutations = (nperm=999))   #no axis signif
```

### for species abundances across axes
```{r}
#1b
SbyS_r1b_sub <- SbyS_r1b[rownames(SbyS_r1b) %in% rownames(SbyE_r1b_sub), ]
SbyS_r1b_sub <- SbyS_r1b_sub[, colSums(SbyS_r1b_sub) >0]
SbyS_rel_r1b <- data.frame(decostand(SbyS_r1b_sub, method = 'total')) # on rel. abun.
cca_fitSpp_r1b <- envfit(cca_r1b, SbyS_rel_r1b, perm = 999) 
signif_asvs_r1b <- names(cca_fitSpp_r1b$vectors$pvals)[cca_fitSpp_r1b$vectors$pvals<=0.01]
length(signif_asvs_r1b)

#1f
SbyS_r1f_sub <- SbyS_r1f[rownames(SbyS_r1f) %in% rownames(SbyE_r1f_sub), ]
SbyS_r1f_sub <- SbyS_r1f_sub[, colSums(SbyS_r1f_sub) >0]
SbyS_rel_r1f <- data.frame(decostand(SbyS_r1f_sub, method = 'total')) # on rel. abun.
cca_fitSpp_r1f <- envfit(cca_r1f, SbyS_rel_r1f, perm = 999) 
signif_asvs_r1f <- names(cca_fitSpp_r1f$vectors$pvals)[cca_fitSpp_r1f$vectors$pvals<=0.01]
length(signif_asvs_r1f)

#2b
SbyS_r2b_sub <- SbyS_r2b[rownames(SbyS_r2b) %in% rownames(SbyE_r2b_sub), ]
SbyS_r2b_sub <- SbyS_r2b_sub[, colSums(SbyS_r2b_sub) >0]
SbyS_rel_r2b <- data.frame(decostand(SbyS_r2b_sub, method = 'total')) # on rel. abun.
cca_fitSpp_r2b <- envfit(cca_r2b, SbyS_rel_r2b, perm = 999)
signif_asvs_r2b <- names(cca_fitSpp_r2b$vectors$pvals)[cca_fitSpp_r2b$vectors$pvals<=0.01]
length(signif_asvs_r2b)

#2f
SbyS_r2f_sub <- SbyS_r2f[rownames(SbyS_r2f) %in% rownames(SbyE_r2f_sub), ]
SbyS_r2f_sub <- SbyS_r2f_sub[, colSums(SbyS_r2f_sub) >0]
SbyS_rel_r2f <- data.frame(decostand(SbyS_r2f_sub, method = 'total')) # on rel. abun.
cca_fitSpp_r2f <- envfit(cca_r2f, SbyS_rel_r2f, perm = 999) 
signif_asvs_r2f <- names(cca_fitSpp_r2f$vectors$pvals)[cca_fitSpp_r2f$vectors$pvals<=0.01]
length(signif_asvs_r2f)
```
* For significant taxa, if pval < 0.05 then: r1b 30, r1f 7, r2b 69, r2f 34 
* but fewer signif taxa if pval < 0.01


### Create dataframes
```{r, include = FALSE}
## constrained eigs divided by sum of constrained + unconstrained/residual eigs
explain_r1b <- round(cca_r1b$CCA$eig/sum(c(cca_r1b$CCA$eig,cca_r1b$CA$eig)),3)*100; explain_r1b
explain_r1f <- round(cca_r1f$CCA$eig/sum(c(cca_r1f$CCA$eig,cca_r1f$CA$eig)),3)*100; explain_r1f
explain_r2b <- round(cca_r2b$CCA$eig/sum(c(cca_r2b$CCA$eig,cca_r2b$CA$eig)),3)*100; explain_r2b
explain_r2f <- round(cca_r2f$CCA$eig/sum(c(cca_r2f$CCA$eig,cca_r2f$CA$eig)),3)*100; explain_r2f


## dataframe of weighted average sample scores
#1b
cca_samp_r1b <- data.frame(scores(cca_r1b, display = "wa"))
cca_samp_r1b$ids <- rownames(cca_samp_r1b) 
cca_samp_r1b <- merge(cca_samp_r1b, SbyE_r1b, 
            by.x = "ids", by.y = "Sample_ID", all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
#1f
cca_samp_r1f <- data.frame(scores(cca_r1f, display = "wa"))
cca_samp_r1f$ids <- rownames(cca_samp_r1f) 
cca_samp_r1f <- merge(cca_samp_r1f, SbyE_r1f, 
            by.x = "ids", by.y = "Sample_ID", all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
#2b
cca_samp_r2b <- data.frame(scores(cca_r2b, display = "wa"))
cca_samp_r2b$ids <- rownames(cca_samp_r2b)
cca_samp_r2b <- merge(cca_samp_r2b, SbyE_r2b,
            by.x = "ids", by.y = "Sample_ID", all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
# 2f
cca_samp_r2f <- data.frame(scores(cca_r2f, display = "wa"))
cca_samp_r2f$ids <- rownames(cca_samp_r2f) 
cca_samp_r2f <- merge(cca_samp_r2f, SbyE_r2f, 
            by.x = "ids", by.y = "Sample_ID", all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)


## dataframe of environmental vectors
#1b
cca_vec_r1b <- data.frame(scores(cca_r1b, display = "bp")) #biplot scores
rownames(cca_vec_r1b) <- c(colnames(SbyE_r1b_sub))
cca_vec_r1b$vecs <- rownames(cca_vec_r1b)
#1f
cca_vec_r1f <- data.frame(scores(cca_r1f, display = "bp")) #biplot scores
rownames(cca_vec_r1f) <- c(colnames(SbyE_r1f_sub))
cca_vec_r1f$vecs <- rownames(cca_vec_r1f)
#2b
cca_vec_r2b <- data.frame(scores(cca_r2b, display = "bp")) #biplot scores
rownames(cca_vec_r2b) <- c(colnames(SbyE_r2b_sub))
cca_vec_r2b$vecs <- rownames(cca_vec_r2b)
#2f
cca_vec_r2f <- data.frame(scores(cca_r2f, display = "bp")) #biplot scores
rownames(cca_vec_r2f) <- c(colnames(SbyE_r2f_sub))
cca_vec_r2f$vecs <- rownames(cca_vec_r2f)


## dataframe of species (ASV) scores (scaled to results scores)
## subset to only significant ones
#1b
cca_spp_r1b <- data.frame(scores(cca_r1b, display = "species", scaling = "sites")) 
cca_spp_r1b$asvs <- rownames(cca_spp_r1b) 
cca_spp_signif_r1b <- cca_spp_r1b %>% filter(asvs %in% signif_asvs_r1b)
#1f
cca_spp_r1f <- data.frame(scores(cca_r1f, display = "species", scaling = "sites")) 
cca_spp_r1f$asvs <- rownames(cca_spp_r1f) 
cca_spp_signif_r1f <- cca_spp_r1f %>% filter(asvs %in% signif_asvs_r1f)
#2b
cca_spp_r2b <- data.frame(scores(cca_r2b, display = "species", scaling = "sites"))
cca_spp_r2b$asvs <- rownames(cca_spp_r2b)
cca_spp_signif_r2b <- cca_spp_r2b %>% filter(asvs %in% signif_asvs_r2b)
#2f
cca_spp_r2f <- data.frame(scores(cca_r2f, display = "species", scaling = "sites")) 
cca_spp_r2f$asvs <- rownames(cca_spp_r2f) 
cca_spp_signif_r2f <- cca_spp_r2f %>% filter(asvs %in% signif_asvs_r2f)
```

    # samples
    geom_point(data = cca_samp_r1b, aes(x = CCA1, y = CCA2, 
        color = Strain, shape = Chamber.Rep) , size = 3) +

## R2f - remove sample cluster w/ high Cladosporium
```{r, fig.keep = 'none'}
# remove samples with high proportional asv6 or high asv141
ggplot() +
    geom_text(data = cca_samp_r2f, aes(x = CCA1, y = CCA2, label = ids,
        color = Strain) , size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual("", values = strain_col) +
    xlim(2.5, 3.3) + ylim(-3,-1.9)
# 9 PH1 (6 howard), 8 Tri5 (5 howard)
cca_samp_r2f %>% filter(CCA1 > 2.5) %>% filter(CCA2 < -1.9) %>% 
    pull(ids) %>% as.character -> to_remove

# make new main datasets
SbyE_r2f_sub2 <- SbyE_r2f_sub[rownames(SbyE_r2f_sub) %nin% to_remove,]
VST_r2f_sub2 <- VST_r2f_sub[rownames(VST_r2f_sub) %nin% to_remove, ]

# run cca
cca_r2f_sub <- vegan::cca(VST_r2f_sub2 ~ SbyE_r2f_sub2 )
# permutation tests:
### for ordination
cca_fit_r2f_sub <- envfit(cca_r2f_sub, SbyE_r2f_sub2, perm = 999) 
cca_fit_r2f_sub #both variables signif
### for cca under reduced model
anova(cca_r2f_sub, by = "axis", permutations = (nperm=999))   #CCA1 semi-signif
### for species abundances
SbyS_r2f_sub2 <- SbyS_r2f[rownames(SbyS_r2f) %in% rownames(SbyE_r2f_sub2), ]
SbyS_r2f_sub2 <- SbyS_r2f_sub2[, colSums(SbyS_r2f_sub2) >0]
SbyS_rel_r2f_sub <- data.frame(decostand(SbyS_r2f_sub2, method = 'total')) # on rel. abun.
cca_fitSpp_r2f_sub <- envfit(cca_r2f_sub, SbyS_rel_r2f_sub, perm = 999) 
signif_asvs_r2f_sub <- names(cca_fitSpp_r2f_sub$vectors$pvals)[cca_fitSpp_r2f_sub$vectors$pvals<=0.01]
length(signif_asvs_r2f_sub) #3
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
# create dataframes
explain_r2f_sub <- round(cca_r2f_sub$CCA$eig/sum(c(cca_r2f_sub$CCA$eig,cca_r2f_sub$CA$eig)),3)*100; explain_r2f_sub
cca_samp_r2f_sub <- data.frame(scores(cca_r2f_sub, display = "wa"))
cca_samp_r2f_sub$ids <- rownames(cca_samp_r2f_sub) 
cca_samp_r2f_sub <- merge(cca_samp_r2f_sub, SbyE_r2f, 
            by.x = "ids", by.y = "Sample_ID", all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
cca_vec_r2f_sub <- data.frame(scores(cca_r2f_sub, display = "bp")) #biplot scores
rownames(cca_vec_r2f_sub) <- c(colnames(SbyE_r2f_sub2))
cca_vec_r2f_sub$vecs <- rownames(cca_vec_r2f_sub)

cca_spp_r2f_sub <- data.frame(scores(cca_r2f_sub, display = "species", scaling = "sites")) 
cca_spp_r2f_sub$asvs <- rownames(cca_spp_r2f_sub) 
cca_spp_signif_r2f_sub <- cca_spp_r2f_sub %>% filter(asvs %in% signif_asvs_r2f_sub)

#figure
c_r2f_sub <- ggplot() + #coord_equal() + 
    # samples
    geom_point(data = cca_samp_r2f_sub, aes(x = CCA1, y = CCA2, 
        color = Strain, shape = Chamber.Rep) , size = 3) +
    # species
    geom_text(data = cca_spp_signif_r2f_sub, aes(x = CCA1, y = CCA2, label = asvs), 
        size = 3) +
    # env vectors
    geom_segment(data = cca_vec_r2f_sub, 
         aes(x = 0, xend = CCA1, y = 0, yend = CCA2),
         arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.8,
         colour = "gray30", linetype = 1 ) +
    geom_text(data = cca_vec_r2f_sub,
         aes(x = c(CCA1+0.4), y = c(CCA2+0.2), label = vecs),
         size = 5, colour = "gray30", fontface = 'bold') +
    scale_colour_manual("Strain", values = strain_col) +
    scale_shape_manual("Chamber", values = c(16,15)) +
    scale_x_continuous(paste("CCA Axis-1 (", explain_r2f_sub[1], "%)", sep = "")) +
    scale_y_continuous(paste("CCA Axis-2 (", explain_r2f_sub[2], "%)", sep = "")) +
    theme(legend.position = 'inside', legend.position.inside = c(.87,.75), 
          legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "cm"), legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0, "cm")) 
c_r2f_sub #+ guides(color = 'none', shape = 'none')
```
